integrity: All stated checks were performed on the accompanying standalone program and the current mathematical claim. The work was reviewed on correctness, originality and value, but not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to finite odd-characteristic fields, dimension >=2, zero-annihilator evolution algebras with one-dimensional square, and uniformly weighted ordered natural bases. Exact all-dimension character sums are proved; finite checks cover sample fields only. The bilinear-form classification and character sums are classical inputs. Equivalent unindexed literature remains a possibility.
title: Exact natural-basis graph profiles for rank-one evolution algebras over odd finite fields
